name: ui-layer-explode
title: Volumetric Menu
description: Ba lớp menu nghiêng 3D xếp chồng tách ra theo chiều dọc (−56 / 0 / +56 px) bằng lò xo lệch nhịp, có đường nối các góc, rồi gộp lại.

moworks.author: moworks

options.panels: selector of the panel wrappers, top first

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Three panels 150x92 (ONE accent on top, TWO, THREE) tilted rotateX −57° and rotateY −29° (perspective 520), stacked. Separation along screen Y: −56 / 0 / +56 px (plus a 4 px base step) on springs k200 c20, the middle at 0.45 s, the outer ones 60 ms later (bottom +40 ms more). Dashed lines join the corners once apart; y readouts at the side. Collapse 2.9-3.35 s power2.inOut. Params: tilt (rotX 57°, rotY 29°) · spread (56 px) · spring (k200 c20) · each (0.06 s) · collapse (0.45 s).
